name: Crystal of Isabel
source:
Isabel starts working at a school for the first time. But her attention is drawn to three boys. What kind of relationship will she have with them? It depends only on her.

[From [url=https://kageboushi.itch.io/crystal-of-isabel]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
伊莎贝尔第一次进入一所学校工作，而三名少年很快吸引了她的注意。她将与他们发展出怎样的关系？一切全凭她自己决定。

[摘自[url=https://kageboushi.itch.io/crystal-of-isabel]itch.io[/url]]
